newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - business remains sluggish.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - business remains sluggish.

text.p: New York physical coffee business remained sporadic this week, as roasters shifted their focus to coffees for delivery against the CSCE December contract.
With CSCE September maintaining a hefty 11-cent premium to December ahead of its expiry, few buyers were willing to buy coffee priced off the spot contract.
"They are waiting for the September position to get satisfied so they can price coffee against December," one trader said.
Traders said spot differentials held firm despite the change in basis months, with a shortage of coffee expected through October.
However, differentials on coffee for forward delivery eased slightly in anticipation of upcoming harvests.

Colombian MAMs for November-December delivery were heard at 19 cents over the CSCE December contract this morning, compared to 22 cents over December last week. However, a small quantity of spot Colombia MAMs netted 30 cents over December, unchanged from a week ago.
